name: The Fragments Within
summary: At the eastern cliffs, the red crystal holds something that moonwell water can reveal. You return to examine it and report to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

sections.title: A Grim Revelation
sections.body: Blessed moonwell water clears the crimson crystal's cloudy surface. Several small bone fragments and half a humanoid jawbone lie trapped inside the dense mineral. The crystal is so tough that even powerful spells would struggle to break it. Whatever entity or artifact left these remains, they have been preserved in isolation above the Darkshore coast.

sections.title: Reporting to Auberdine
sections.body: Back in Auberdine, Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea hears what you found. The discovery gives the local night elf leaders more cause for concern, but no clear answers. Glynda will present the findings to the town council. She takes some comfort in the crystal's position high on the eastern cliffs, far enough from town to pose no immediate danger.

faq.q: What is trapped inside the red crystal?
faq.answer: Blessed moonwell water makes the red crystal clear enough to reveal several bone fragments and half a humanoid jawbone embedded inside.

faq.q: Can the crystal be broken open to inspect the bones?
faq.answer: The crystal is exceptionally resilient, and even powerful magic would struggle to break it open. The bones' exact identity remains unknown.

faq.q: Who do you report the findings to?
aliases: who turns in the fragments within
faq.answer: You report your findings to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in the port town of Auberdine.

faq.q: What will the Sentinels do about the crystal?
aliases: what happens next with the crystal
faq.answer: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea plans to inform the council in Auberdine so its members can consider what to do. The crystal rests high in the eastern cliffs, so they do not see it as an urgent threat.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know that humanoid bones trapped in strange crystal along the mountain borders of Ashenvale and Felwood call for vigilance from the Sentinels guarding Darkshore.
As a druid, you see a curious anomaly in a mineral that resists natural wear and powerful magic alike, beyond the usual balance of the wild.
